title: Keys held down
description:
Track which keys are held from key-down and key-up messages, ignoring auto-repeat.

```
WM_KEYDOWN A (first press)  -> A down
WM_KEYDOWN A (repeat)        -> ignored (bit 30 set)
WM_KEYDOWN SHIFT             -> held: A, SHIFT
WM_KEYUP A                   -> held: SHIFT
```
hints: Clear `m_pressed` at the start of each frame.
requirements: Messages carry a virtual key and the `lParam` bits; bit 30 is "was already down".
stretch: Lose all held keys on `WM_KILLFOCUS`, so a key released in another window does not stay stuck.
